FE-00.name: Opportunity Selection
FE-00.accept: Evidence-backed current feasible positive candidate or NO_ECONOMIC_GO; historical cases only qualify logic, never current tradeability.

FE-01.name: One-Class Freeze
FE-01.accept: Verified deployed ProgramData/source, group, banks, oracles, integrations, exact protocol/state parity and one genuinely executable funding class.

FE-02.name: Executable Economics
FE-02.accept: Complete protocol-exact repay/seize, funding/route/min-out, signed TX plan/full simulation, conservative fees and exit; positive executable net edge or NOT_ACTIONABLE.

FE-03.name: Targeted Production Shadow
FE-03.accept: Production-core replay/shadow plus positive/negative candidate evidence and measured winner/latency/loss reasons; no shadow profit as realized.

FE-04.name: Serial Safety and Accounting
FE-04.accept: Versioned one-shot approval, one in-flight attempt, persistent holds, double-send prevention, crash/unknown HALT, finalized wallet/fee/exit reconciliation.

FE-05.name: Read-only Preflight
FE-05.accept: Separately authorized bounded FREE_ONLY Mainnet observation, protocol/fee/simulation/candidate evidence; PILOT_READY or BLOCKED.

FE-06.name: Controlled One-Shot Mainnet
FE-06.accept: Explicit separate user approval for code/wallet/program/budget/limits; one submission attempt, then HALT; no auto-rearm.

FE-07.name: Realized Net PnL
FE-07.accept: Finalized signature/token/SOL/fee/tip/inventory/actual exit and all cumulative failed costs; positive cumulative realized only = FIRST_REALIZED_PROFIT_EVIDENCED.
